feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Windows 11 26H2
feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Not fixed yet: Printing fails for documents with zero-size images
entry.summary: Printing can fail when a document contains an image with zero height or width at the selected resolution. These images can be invisible. Mainly Word documents printed through GDI, but other apps can be affected. Confirmed by Microsoft. No fix date announced. Affects: Windows 11 26H2. Source: https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/15/microsoft-confirms-november-windows-updates-cause-activation-error-0x80041008-and-printing-failures/. From Patchmap (news and vendor reports).

entry.title: Fix rolling out: November update fails to install (0x800f0993, 0x800f0989, 0x80070306)
entry.summary: Some devices that installed the October 2026 preview update KB5127936 can't finish installing the November security update and may retry repeatedly. Microsoft says a fix is rolling out for devices using Windows Update. Sources disagree on whether it has fully shipped. Affects: Windows 11 26H2. Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-confirms-kb5132061-installation-issues-0x80070306-0x800f0989-0x800f0993-errors/. From Patchmap (news and vendor reports).

entry.title: Fix available: Activation and licensing commands fail with 0x80041008
entry.summary: Activation, KMS configuration or product key commands (for example slmgr) can fail with error 0x80041008, especially with automated licensing tools. Reported fixed by an out-of-band update on 13 Nov 2026. Server packages are in the Microsoft Update Catalog only. Check Microsoft's KB page for your version. Affects: Windows 11 26H2. Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/servicing/os/windows-11/2026/11/kb5131087-windows-11-23h2-security-update. From Patchmap (news and vendor reports).
